vars.label: Places on the National Register of Historic Places (NPS)
vars.ref: NPS National Register of Historic Places, public locations, edited up to 2026-08-07
vars.definition: Buildings, structures, sites, objects and historic districts of Puerto Rico listed on the National Register of Historic Places, in the municipio that holds each listing's point. A listing with points in several municipios (a historic road or an irrigation system) counts in each, so the municipal values add up to more than Puerto Rico's, which counts each listing once. Every listing counts, private residences too, although the map does not draw those. Restricted and sensitive listings, such as archaeological sites, are not in the public data.

vars.label: Comunidades Especiales (2006 delimitation)
vars.ref: Junta de Planificación, Comunidades Especiales delimitation (2006)
vars.definition: How many Comunidades Especiales each municipio has. From the Junta de Planificación's 2006 delimitation of the Comunidades Especiales (713 communities), placed in the municipio the Junta gives each one. A 2006 designation: communities named later may be missing.

vars.label: Housing units in Comunidades Especiales (2006 inventory)
vars.ref: Junta de Planificación, Comunidades Especiales delimitation (2006)
vars.definition: Housing units counted inside the Comunidades Especiales of each municipio by the 2006 inventory. From the Junta de Planificación's 2006 delimitation of the Comunidades Especiales (713 communities), placed in the municipio the Junta gives each one. A 2006 designation: communities named later may be missing.

vars.label: Substance use and mental health treatment facilities (SAMHSA)
vars.definition: All the facilities below: substance use treatment, mental health treatment or both. Facilities that answered SAMHSA's National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey of 2024 and are listed in its National Directories, in the municipio of their address. A facility listed in both directories counts once. The directories leave out facilities that did not answer or asked not to be listed, and most individual practitioners.

vars.label: Treatment facilities: substance use only (SAMHSA)
vars.definition: Facilities that offer substance use treatment and not mental health treatment. Facilities that answered SAMHSA's National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey of 2024 and are listed in its National Directories, in the municipio of their address. A facility listed in both directories counts once. The directories leave out facilities that did not answer or asked not to be listed, and most individual practitioners.

vars.label: Treatment facilities: mental health only (SAMHSA)
vars.definition: Facilities that offer mental health treatment and not substance use treatment. Facilities that answered SAMHSA's National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey of 2024 and are listed in its National Directories, in the municipio of their address. A facility listed in both directories counts once. The directories leave out facilities that did not answer or asked not to be listed, and most individual practitioners.

vars.label: Treatment facilities: both substance use and mental health (SAMHSA)
vars.definition: Facilities that offer both substance use treatment and mental health treatment. Facilities that answered SAMHSA's National Substance Use and Mental Health Services Survey of 2024 and are listed in its National Directories, in the municipio of their address. A facility listed in both directories counts once. The directories leave out facilities that did not answer or asked not to be listed, and most individual practitioners.

nps_nrhp.name: National Park Service — National Register of Historic Places, public locations (map service)
nps_nrhp.license: Public domain (US Government work; the service's licence field says 'For general public distribution')
nps_nrhp.note: Listed historic places of Puerto Rico. The observatory publishes each listing's name, type, municipio, listing date and point, not its address; private residences, and listings named by a street address, are counted but not drawn. Restricted and sensitive listings are not in the service.

samhsa_nsumhss.name: SAMHSA — National Directories of substance use and mental health treatment facilities (N-SUMHSS)
samhsa_nsumhss.license: Public domain (SAMHSA's Public Domain Notice in the directories; they may not be reproduced or distributed for a fee)
samhsa_nsumhss.note: Treatment facilities counted by municipio and type of care. The observatory publishes counts only: no facility name, address, telephone or point.

jp_comunidades_especiales.name: Junta de Planificación — Delimitation of the Comunidades Especiales (2006)
jp_comunidades_especiales.license: No data license stated (public layer of the Junta de Planificación)
jp_comunidades_especiales.note: Counted by municipio from comunidades.geojson (python comunidades.py).
